comments.author: @ImpossibleTravelogue99
comments.text: What a poetic story! Turning empty oil drums into the joyous steelpan—now honored with a UN World Day—made my heart soar. Bravo!

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Living in Trinidad & Tobago must be something unique, especially knowing that these incredible creatures come ashore every year to lay their eggs. I’d love to experience the local culture, hear the stories of the people, and see this natural wonder with my own eyes.

replies.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
replies.text: The leatherback turtles at Grande Riviere are truly a sight to behold, and there is so much rich culture to discover across the islands! 🐢

comments.author: @lifeonearth68
comments.text: Seeing a giant leatherback turtle come out of the ocean at night must be unforgettable. I can't imagine standing on the beach watching something that big move across the sand. Anyone here seen one in person? 😁😁

replies.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
replies.text: It really is an unforgettable experience to see them up close, and I’m sure many of our viewers who have visited Grande Riviere would agree with you! 😁
